java.scope: Java and templates; subsequent changes were CSS only, then the final JAR passed all browser suites.

checks.assertion: Visible filters, eligible count and actual shared interests; removing one filter preserves the other.
Short mouse drag returns the same card and sends zero decisions.
Empty results offer working clear/revisit actions; revisiting keeps filters.
Committed mouse swipe sends exactly one like; a one-sided like stays in discovery.
Reciprocal button like opens real feedback, correct chat and a message received by the other participant.
Repeated arrow-key events during commitment submit one decision.
390 px emulated touch: short drag returns; committed swipe submits once.
390 px discovery/empty states and Chinese controls have no horizontal overflow and submit the same action.
390 px match feedback and Chinese/reduced-motion mode preserve the conversation destination.
Reduced-motion button decision submits once.
A delayed response shows saving/busy feedback; duplicate input cannot submit a second decision.
Real Back navigation and an explicit persisted-pageshow event refresh eligibility and restore usable controls.
With JavaScript disabled, native CSRF-protected buttons still submit the same validated action.
A profile hidden in another session returns a real 404; recovery keeps both filters at 390 px.
Ending the connection denies an old match link and keeps a usable, filtered discovery destination.
No browser exceptions or HTTP 5xx responses during these flows.
Incoming messages show a recipient-only badge; opening the conversation acknowledges the current participant and clears it.
A later incoming message becomes unread again and a new acknowledgement clears it.
More than 100 messages load in a bounded page, remain ascending and contain no duplicates.
A polling result arriving after older-history paging merges by ID without duplicates or reordering.
A 1,000-character message remains readable without horizontal page overflow.
Keyboard navigation reaches the send control and Enter submits the message.
An empty conversation shows a usable composer without a misleading load-history control.
The desktop conversation remains usable at 390 px without horizontal overflow.
An ended conversation returns a real 403 error state that remains readable at 390 px.
No browser exceptions or HTTP 5xx responses during the checked flows.

checks: Real filter form narrows the available card and preserves shared interests.
Discovery and filter sheet fit 320, 375, 390 and 768 px; decision buttons remain reachable.
Two real demo sessions match, send messages and show the actual unread count.
Saved profile, safety and mobile logout are accessible; logout protects discovery.
Public entry, login, signup and privacy fit a 320 px viewport.
No browser JavaScript errors or failed app / asset responses.
